APPLICATION PLANNING

Recommended Uses

17 oz collapsible cup

Camping & Outdoor ↗

A 17 oz silicone cup that collapses to a few centimetres: Collapses to palm size and slides into a pack side pocket.

Beach Parties ↗

Pressed flat to shake the sand out, taking no room in the bag.

Tailgate & Car Parties ↗

Lives in the glovebox; twenty come out when the lot fills up.

Confirm for your project

Check packed size, pack space and the temperature of hot drinks；the venue's no-glass rule, wind and sand exposure, and how it gets washed；venue container rules, pour size and how it travels in the car.

These are selection suggestions. Review the chosen configuration and sample against your intended use.
